text: Landed; ticket was never closed. Xlsx.scala reads via JDK StAX and does NOT trust the declared dimension. Plus style-only rows are not rows, shared strings resolve, non-zip refuses rather than throwing, external entity not resolved. Fixtures synthetic only, rule 14(d).
